content:
**Top 5 richest people who were U.S. citizens in 2022 (according to the 2022 Forbes “World’s Billionaires” list) and the undergraduate institution they attended**

| Rank (2022) | Person | Net‑worth in 2022* | Undergraduate university (or where they began their studies) | Notes on degree |
|-------------|--------|-------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------|
| 1 | **Elon Musk** | ≈ $219 billion | **University of Pennsylvania** – The Wharton School (B.S. in Economics) and College of Arts & Sciences (B.S. in Physics) | Transferred to Penn after two years at Queen’s University (Canada). |
| 2 | **Jeff Bezos** | ≈ $171 billion | **Princeton University** – B.S.E. in Electrical Engineering & Computer Science | Graduated 1986. |
| 3 | **Bill Gates** | ≈ $129 billion | **Harvard University** – Undergraduate studies in Computer Science (did not graduate) | Left Harvard in 1975 to start Microsoft. |
| 4 | **Warren Buffett** | ≈ $96 billion | **University of Nebraska‑Lincoln** – B.S. in Business Administration (1950) | Later earned an M.B.A. from Columbia University. |
| 5 | **Larry Ellison** | ≈ $93 billion | **University of Illinois at Urbana‑Champaign** – Attended 1969‑1971 (no degree) | Dropped out and later attended the University of Chicago (also did not graduate). |

\*Net‑worth figures are rounded and reflect the values reported by **Forbes** in its 2022 billionaire rankings (published December 2022).  

### Sources

| Fact | Source |
|------|--------|
| Forbes 2022 U.S. billionaire rankings (Musk, Bezos, Gates, Buffett, Ellison) | Forbes, *The World’s Billionaires 2022* – “United States” filter (https://www.forbes.com/billionaires/) |
| Elon Musk – undergraduate education | Biography, *University of Pennsylvania* alumni records; Wikipedia “Elon Musk” (education section) |
| Jeff Bezos – undergraduate education | Princeton University alumni database; Wikipedia “Jeff Bezos” (education) |
| Bill Gates – undergraduate education | Harvard University alumni notes; Wikipedia “Bill Gates” (education) |
| Warren Buffett – undergraduate education | University of Nebraska‑Lincoln alumni records; Wikipedia “Warren Buffett” (education) |
| Larry Ellison – undergraduate attendance | University of Illinois archives; Wikipedia “Larry Ellison” (education) |

### Quick take‑away
- All five of the United States’ richest individuals in 2022 attended a university for their undergraduate studies, though three (Gates, Ellison, and Musk’s early years) did not complete a degree at their first institution.
- The schools represented are a mix of elite private universities (Penn, Princeton, Harvard) and public institutions (Nebraska‑Lincoln, Illinois).
